LaunchProfileRecord.title: LaunchProfileRecord
LaunchProfileRecord.description: Cloud-persisted Minecraft Java launch configuration and JVM tuning profile owned by an authenticated user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the profile owner.

profileName.description: Human-readable name of the saved launch profile.

allocatedMemoryMb.description: Allocated JVM heap size in megabytes (-Xmx).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

DiagnosticReportRecord.title: DiagnosticReportRecord
DiagnosticReportRecord.description: Pre-launch diagnostic check and automatic repair log entry stored in Firestore.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the report owner.

versionId.description: Target Minecraft version inspected before launch.

totalChecks.description: Number of pre-launch diagnostic checks executed.

repairedIssuesCount.description: Number of launch-blocking issues automatically repaired.

summary.description: Concise diagnostic summary of verified and repaired components.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when diagnostic report was recorded (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/launch_profiles/{profile.description: Per-user cloud collection of saved Minecraft Java launch configurations.

/users/{userId}/diagnostic_reports/{repo.description: Per-user cloud log of pre-launch diagnostics and auto-repairs.
